text:
maya: Quick idea — add an "insight slices" toggle in Console so users can switch between per-route and per-model metrics without rebuilding filters. Need alignment on API + saved-query semantics before I mock UI.
sam: +1. Two main options: make scope orthogonal to saved queries (URL param only) or bake scope into saved queries. Both have tradeoffs.
joel: frontend POV: orthogonal scope = easier deep links (`?scope=model`) and avoids duplication of saved queries. But we must surface which scope a saved query was last used with.
maya: UX concern — people will expect 'save' to remember what they were looking at. Maybe saved queries get an optional `preferred_scope` that doesn't force the runtime.
nina: telemetry note: per-model view increases cardinality massively. We should precompute rollups for top-N models per route and fallback to on-demand aggregation for the tail.
priya: infra: precomputed rollups are fine, but we need TTL + compact keys. Also per-model scans could hit customers' analytics quotas — we need quota bake-in and a fallback UX.
sam: sketching an API contract — open to comments:

```
GET /api/console/insights?scope=model&route_id=abc&filters=...&saved_query_id=123
Response: { "buckets": [...], "meta": { "scope": "model", "sample_rate": "0.05" } }
```
Question: Should `saved_query_id` imply scope? or should API return `saved_query.preferred_scope` but honor `scope` param if present?
joel: prefer saved query not to *force* scope. Returned saved_query can include `preferred_scope` and the UI shows that as a default. Explicit `scope` query param should override.
maya: agreed. UX suggestion: saved-query preview cards show a tiny badge like "last used: model" and a small toggle to set default scope for that saved query.
nina: telemetry instrumentation: emit `console.saved_query.apply` with fields `effective_scope`, `saved_query_id`, `sample_rate`, and `query_cardinality_estimate`.
priya: rollout plan: gate behind feature flag `insights.slices`. Start staging 50% -> prod 10% then ramp. Add an alert if query latency > 2s with per-customer tail metrics.
sam: also need to update quota docs and create a soft-fail UX: if per-model on-demand aggregation exceeds threshold, show truncated results and CTA to run full job or use rollup.
joel: implementation notes: keep URL deep-linkable: `?sq=123&scope=model&tz=UTC`. Show spinner for on-demand aggregation and a progress hint for long-running tail queries.
maya: access controls: saved_query lookup must honor org/team ACLs. Do not leak saved queries cross-org — check `saved_query.org_id == requester.org_id`.
sam: agree. Also add a small rate-limit on ad-hoc per-model aggregation per-org to protect infra.
maya: next steps — I'll draft a short spec with UI mocks + API patch. @sam @nina can you review API by EOD Friday?
sam: will review.
nina: will review.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature-flag branch -> staging at 2024-11-19T03:12Z :rocket:
maya: thanks, I'll post the spec in #product-docs when ready."
